question: What did the Larkfield council decide about the Main Street bike lane?

sources.title: Larkfield Gazette, 14 March 2026
sources.text: The Larkfield town council voted 5-4 on Tuesday to delay construction of the Main Street bike lane until April 2027. Councillor Dana Ortiz, who chairs the transport committee, said the delay was needed because the project's cost estimate had risen to $2.4 million. Supporters argued that delaying would add roughly $300,000 in inflation costs.

response: The Larkfield council voted 5-4 to delay the Main Street bike lane until April 2027. The decision was driven by a cost estimate that had risen to $4.2 million. Councillor Dana Ortiz, who chairs the finance committee, defended the delay. Critics of the delay warned it could add about $300,000 in costs. Overall, it was a sensible compromise.

question: When does the Brightwater Library open on weekends, and does it have parking?

sources.title: Brightwater Library: visitor information (updated 2 June 2026)
sources.text: Opening hours: Monday to Friday 9:00-20:00; Saturday 10:00-17:00; Sunday 12:00-16:00. The library has 40 free parking spaces, including 4 accessible spaces. Parking is limited to three hours.

sources.title: Brightwater Library: visitor information (archived, January 2024)
sources.text: Opening hours: Monday to Friday 9:00-19:00; Saturday 10:00-16:00; closed on Sundays. There are 25 free parking spaces.

response: On weekends the library opens Saturday 10:00-17:00 and Sunday 12:00-16:00. It has 25 free parking spaces. Parking is limited to three hours. The library also offers free Wi-Fi throughout the building.

question: Summarise the results of the Norvale clinical trial for the drug Kelotrin.

sources.title: Norvale Research Institute press release, 9 September 2026
sources.text: In a 12-week trial of 480 adults with mild hypertension, Kelotrin lowered systolic blood pressure by an average of 8 mmHg compared with placebo. The most common side effect was headache, reported by 11% of participants taking Kelotrin. The trial was not designed to measure effects on heart attacks or strokes. Regulators have not yet approved the drug.

response: The Norvale trial enrolled 480 adults with mild hypertension over 12 weeks. Kelotrin lowered systolic blood pressure by about 8 mmHg versus placebo. Headache was the most common side effect, affecting 11% of participants on the drug. The trial also showed Kelotrin reduces the risk of heart attacks. Kelotrin is expected to be approved next year.

question: Who founded Quillon Robotics and what does it make?

sources.title: Quillon Robotics: about us
sources.text: Quillon Robotics was founded in 2019 by Priya Raman and Tomas Lindqvist in Gothenburg, Sweden. The company makes autonomous robots for inspecting wind turbine blades. It employs around 140 people.

response: Quillon Robotics was founded in 2019 by Priya Raman and Tomas Lindqvist. It is based in Stockholm, Sweden. The company builds autonomous robots that inspect wind turbine blades. It has around 140 employees.

question: What changed in version 3.0 of the Fernhill data export tool?

sources.title: Fernhill Export 3.0 release notes
sources.text: Version 3.0 adds export to Parquet and removes the deprecated XML exporter. The default batch size changes from 500 to 1,000 rows. Python 3.9 is no longer supported; the minimum version is now Python 3.11.

response: Version 3.0 adds Parquet export. It also removes the old XML exporter. The default batch size doubles from 500 to 1,000 rows. The minimum supported Python version is now 3.10.

question: How did Harrowgate's 2025 recycling rate compare with its target?

sources.title: Harrowgate District annual waste report 2025
sources.text: The district recycled 46% of household waste in 2025, up from 41% in 2024. The target for 2025 was 50%. Food waste collection, introduced in May 2025, accounted for most of the increase.

response: Harrowgate recycled 46% of household waste in 2025, beating its 50% target. That was up from 41% the year before. Most of the increase came from the new food waste collection introduced in May 2025.
